items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: They even had Baby Laurence, the dancer, they had him on there. Because Baby Laurence used to make sessions with the musicians. It was just like another instrument. I think he's the greatest tap dancer I've ever seen.

ctx.x: (they spelled 'Sarah' 'S-a-r-a), Beautiful New Vocalist. Art Blakey, Drummer, Kicks Like Mad." They had my name spelled "M-a-l-e-c-h-i" and then they had "Johnny" -- "Johnny Malachi, Brilliant Young Pianist and Arranger." And they had "Tommy Potter, bass." And Don Byas, they had something to say about him There were some other people on it... They even had Baby Laurence, the dancer, they had him on there. Because Baby Laurence used to make sessions with the musicians. It was just like another instrument. I think…

A lot of people ask me, especially students at the school and everything, about Charlie Parker. They think back during those days of him being.... Well, they know of him now as a legend, but they don't realize that back then few people knew him or liked what he was doing, anything. And these were these smart people in New York who were producing these concerts and things, where he is the one that should have been at the top of the page!
